sources.text: The table, the facts and the words on how it is made, from these.

steps.name: break down
steps.note: Lactose is split into equal glucose and galactose by lactase, held fixed on a support.

steps.name: rearrange
steps.note: The galactose is rearranged by an enzyme, L-arabinose isomerase, from a heat-loving microbe, or by calcium hydroxide, an alkali; in one example about 30 % of it converts.

steps.name: separate
steps.note: The tagatose is separated from the glucose by chromatography (running it through a column that sorts the sugars apart), or by fermenting the glucose away.
